test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is true regarding CO₂ ?

options.text: It has a a white foggy colour and a pungent gas - like smell.
It is a linear electrovalent molecule.
The solid form of CO₂ is called dry ice.
It is not soluble in water, ethanol and acetone.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The solid form of CO2 is called dry ice.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Carbon Dioxide**

__
 
• **Transparent to visible light but absorbs infrared radiation**, as a **greenhouse gas**.
 
• Solid form of carbon dioxide is known as **dry ice.**
 
• Used as a **refrigerant, in fire extinguishers, for inflating life rafts and life jackets, blasting coal, foaming rubber and plastics, promoting the growth of plants in greenhouses, immobilizing animals before slaughter, and in carbonated beverages.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Dry Ice

 
• **Colorless, odorless, and non-flammable**, and can** lower the pH **of a solution when dissolved in water, **forming carbonic acid. **
 
• It** sublimates** directly from the **solid state to the gas state.**
 
• Ued for **temporary refrigeration, preserving frozen foods, blasting, etc.**
